case: Four nested PostgreSQL domains over a custom enum
contract: PostgreSQL 16 column metadata resolves four nested domains to the schema-qualified enum leaf.
A schema-aware keyed edit changes the stored label; pg_typeof confirms the four-layer outer domain.
The typed equality filter selects the updated row and preserves an adjacent SQL NULL row.
Independent PostgreSQL value and pg_typeof queries confirm stored labels, SQL NULL and native outer-domain type.

domain_contracts.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Domain chains deeper than four layers remain open.
Other enum session/configuration combinations remain open.
This contract does not close the broader B3 matrix.
